value.rationale: The quantified finite-time power collapse is a canonical invariant of an aperiodic monoid, and all fiber sizes classify the full dynamics rather than one arbitrary parameter. The mod-four square-root oscillation and universal harmonic absorption law distinguish finite arithmetic from asymptotic behavior. Scope is limited to rank-two 0-Hecke systems.
